page.title: Sunset Cruise with Champagne and Tapas in Marbella 2033

data.meta_description: Book a sunset cruise with champagne and tapas in Marbella 2033. Sip cava, sail past Puerto Banús, and watch the sun dip behind La Concha. Prices from €749.

faq.q: What is included in the sunset cruise with champagne and tapas?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, cava or Spanish white wine, light tapas-style snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). Champagne can be upgraded on request.

faq.q: Which boats are available for a sunset cruise in Marbella?
faq.a: For small groups, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) start at €749 for 2 hours. For larger parties, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) costs €4,719 minimum 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. Other boats like the Azimut 58 or Ferretti 94 are available on request.

faq.q: What time does a sunset cruise depart?

faq.q: Can we choose our own route for the sunset cruise?

faq.q: Is the sunset cruise suitable for a proposal or special celebration?

faq.q: How do I book a sunset cruise in Marbella?
faq.a: Contact us via WhatsApp or the booking form on our site. For standard boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), we can confirm immediately. For larger yachts, pricing and availability are provided on request. A deposit secures your slot.

faq.q: Can we bring our own food or drinks?
faq.a: Our charters already include drinks and snacks. You are welcome to bring extra food, but we ask that you avoid glass bottles for safety. The boat has a fridge and cooler for your items.

data.body_html:
Watching the sun sink into the Mediterranean from the deck of a private boat, cava in hand and a plate of jamón ibérico within reach — that is the essence of a sunset cruise with champagne and tapas in Marbella 2033. Departing from the glamorous Puerto Banús, this experience combines luxury, relaxation, and the best coastal views the Costa del Sol has to offer. Whether you are celebrating an anniversary, proposing, or simply unwinding after a day on the Golden Mile, these charters deliver an evening you will not forget. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on a 12.5-metre motor yacht, including skipper, fuel, and all drinks.

Why Choose a Sunset Cruise in Marbella?

Marbella’s coastline faces west, meaning you get front-row seats to the sunset every single evening from spring through autumn. The light turns the sky shades of orange, pink, and violet, while the silhouette of La Concha mountain frames the horizon. A sunset cruise lets you escape the crowded beach bars and experience this show from the water, with no one else around. The sea breeze keeps you cool even in August, and the gentle swell of the Mediterranean adds a sense of calm you will not find on land.

What’s Included in Your Sunset Charter

Every booking includes a licensed English-speaking skipper, fuel, insurance, and all taxes (21% IVA). Onboard, you will find a cooler stocked with water, soft drinks, beer, Spanish white wine, and cava — the Spanish equivalent of champagne. Light tapas-style snacks such as olives, almonds, and cured meats are also provided. You are welcome to bring additional food or a bottle of your favourite champagne. The boat is equipped with a stereo system (Bluetooth), sun pads, and a shaded cockpit.

For smaller parties, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 offer excellent value. If you want to go big, the Mangusta 80 (available in white or grey) provides 24 metres of space and a complimentary jet ski. All boats depart from Puerto Banús.

Typical Sunset Cruise Route

Your skipper will tailor the route to your preferences, but a classic sunset itinerary heads west towards Cabopino or Cala del Faro, passing the mansions of the Golden Mile and the dunes of Artola. You might anchor in a quiet cove for a swim before the sun dips. Alternatively, you can cruise east towards Marbella Marina and the old town. The round trip is typically 1.5–2 hours, with enough time to enjoy a glass of cava as the sky changes colour.

Best Time of Year for a Sunset Cruise

The sunset season in Marbella runs from April to October. In July and August, the sun sets around 21:45, giving you a long, warm evening. May and September offer milder temperatures and fewer crowds. Even in October, you can enjoy a sunset cruise with a light jacket. For the most dramatic colours, book just after a summer storm — the sky becomes electric.

How to Book Your Sunset Cruise

Booking is simple. Contact us via WhatsApp or use the form on our [boat rental Marbella](/experiences/) page. For the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, we can confirm your slot immediately with a deposit. For larger yachts like the Mangusta 80 or Azimut 58, we will provide pricing and availability on request. We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance, especially in July and August.
